# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1648._

> ℹ️ **18 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
🚨 **BLOCKING: the crap4dart `>=0.14.2` pin breaks both CRAP ratchets — this is what made validation CI red (twice)**

The 0.11.x → 0.14.2 bump changes cyclomatic-complexity counting semantics. crap4dart 0.13.0's changelog: *"Cyclomatic complexity now counts switch **expressions**, their `when` guards, `if-case` guards, and `||`/`&&` patterns — previously all uncounted."* The pinned thresholds were measured under the OLD counting and are not repinned in this PR (core `crap4dart.yaml` stays `threshold: 12.0`, `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml` stays `threshold: 30.0`).

Measured on this tree (complexity-only scan, same 8,066 methods under 0.11.0 vs 0.14.2): **310 methods drift up**, e.g. `_defaultRoleStyle` (lib/src/cli/tui_theme.dart) CC 1→21, `HostCapability.id` 1→20, `encodeEvent`/`_kindOf` (lib/src/wire/wire_protocol.dart) 1→17. Since `CRAP = CC²·(1−cov)³ + CC`, every method whose new CC ≥ 13 breaches the 12.0 threshold **even at 100% coverage**.

CI confirms it — both failures are this branch's own bump, not the pre-existing main red:

- Run [#8624](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38885258141) (a318158): `CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)` **exit 2** and `Flutter app CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml)` **exit 2**.
- Run [#8633](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38895381451) (201416d, after the main merges): **both failed again** the same way. Exit 2 is `ExitCodes.thresholdExceeded` — "maximum CRAP score exceeded the configured threshold".

The current head (1461602b) differs from the red 201416d only by the gh-1649 publish fix, so the next validation run fails the same two jobs a third time (owner directive: after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head). Note the pre-commit hook's version case already accepts `0.14.*`, so upgraded dev checkouts hit the same wall locally.

Both red runs also SKIPPED the downstream quality-gate steps (`broken goldens + Type-2 duplication`, app pixel gate) — so the `severity: error` flip has never actually executed in CI.

**Fix (pick one):**
1. Keep the bump, re-measure under 0.14.2 and **deliberately repin both thresholds**, documenting the counting-semantics change in the config comments (same discipline as the previous "bump the ceiling deliberately" rework), **or**
2. Revert this PR's two pin lines to `">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"`, keep only the gh-1646 anti-stop line, and ship the `severity: error` flip + threshold repins as its own card.

For what it's worth, the pixel side of the flip is sound and verified locally at 0.14.2: `broken_goldens` passes clean with the new excludes (225 app + 4 core goldens), `scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed` returns MET, and dropping the single remaining exclude flags exactly `onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` ("solid glyph rectangles") — the config comments are accurate. It's only the CRAP ratchet the bump silently re-broke.

---

### Thread 2 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `v["file"]` can KeyError where the sibling field already uses `.get`**

```python
violations.setdefault(Path(v["file"]).name, v.get("message", ""))
```

`message` is read defensively with `.get(..., "")`, but `file` is indexed directly — a future schema change (or a partial violation entry) raises `KeyError` and kills the harness *after* the JSON already parsed, so the console-format fallback never gets a chance to run. Symmetric handling keeps the dual-mode parsing actually resilient:

```python
path = v.get("file", "")
if path:
    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name, v.get("message", ""))
```

Verified the current 0.14.2 JSON shape (`gates[].violations[].file/.message`) matches this parser, so this is purely forward-hardening, not a live bug.

---

### Thread 3 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
💡 **SUGGESTION: the hardcoded "30/40" residual prose will rot with the next upstream release**

```python
print(f"  detected: {len(reg_violations)}/{total}"
      f" (0/40 = the measured blind spot; 30/40 with"
      f" crap4dart >=0.14.2 — the residual 10 carry only"
      ...
```

The measured count is printed from `len(reg_violations)` (good — the old `len({*reg_violations}) & len(...) and ...` truthiness hack is genuinely gone), but the parenthetical hardcodes `30/40` and "the residual 10" — numbers valid only for exactly 0.14.2. The next detector release that flags one more box makes this line lie on every scoreboard run. Suggest keeping the prose explanation in the module docstring (where the 0.9.5 baseline classes already live) and printing just the measured fraction plus the pinned version, e.g.:

```python
print(f"  detected: {len(reg_violations)}/{total}"
      f" (0/40 = the 0.9.5 blind spot; expectations per detector"
      f" version live in the module docstring)")
```

Also confirmed against the upstream 0.14.2 changelog: "30/40 detected (0/40 before 0.14.1); the residual 10 carry only sub-20 px boxes and the fa_mark logo" — the numbers are correct today, they just won't survive a bump.

---

### Thread 5

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The gh-1646 anti-stop line itself is correct, tested (22/22 targeted tests green, analyzer/format clean), and I verified the bundled `broken_goldens` flip locally (gates pass at `severity: error`, `--expect-fixed` MET, exactly one documented residual). But the bundled crap4dart `>=0.14.2` pin **re-broke both CRAP ratchets** — validation runs #8624 and #8633 failed with exit 2 ("maximum CRAP score exceeded the configured threshold") because 0.13.0+ counts switch expressions/`when` guards/if-case guards that 0.11.x didn't (310 methods drift up on this tree), and the thresholds were not repinned. The current head will fail the same two jobs again.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 BLOCKING — `ci.yml:1668`/`ci.yml:2141`: the 0.14.2 pin breaks the core (12.0) and flutter_app (30.0) CRAP thresholds; red twice, golden-gate steps skipped both times (the `severity: error` flip has never run in CI). Repin deliberately under the new counting, or revert the pin out of this PR.
- ⚠️ IMPORTANT — PR description covers 2 of 6 changed files and its "full-suite delta: zero outside the 8 pre-existing main-red failures" claim contradicts the branch's own CI record (both red runs failed the CRAP gates introduced by this branch's bump). Update the description in rework.
- 💡 2 suggestions — `check_golden_detector.py`: defensive `v["file"]` access; hardcoded "30/40" residual prose.

**Next Steps**:
1. Fix the CRAP ratchet regression (repin both thresholds with justification, or move the pin bump + severity flip to a separate card).
2. Correct the PR description to document the crap4dart bump/flip and the real CI delta.
3. Re-validate; the anti-stop line and the golden-detector flip are otherwise ready.

---

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1648._

> ℹ️ **18 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
🚨 **BLOCKING: the crap4dart `>=0.14.2` pin breaks both CRAP ratchets — this is what made validation CI red (twice)**

The 0.11.x → 0.14.2 bump changes cyclomatic-complexity counting semantics. crap4dart 0.13.0's changelog: *"Cyclomatic complexity now counts switch **expressions**, their `when` guards, `if-case` guards, and `||`/`&&` patterns — previously all uncounted."* The pinned thresholds were measured under the OLD counting and are not repinned in this PR (core `crap4dart.yaml` stays `threshold: 12.0`, `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml` stays `threshold: 30.0`).

Measured on this tree (complexity-only scan, same 8,066 methods under 0.11.0 vs 0.14.2): **310 methods drift up**, e.g. `_defaultRoleStyle` (lib/src/cli/tui_theme.dart) CC 1→21, `HostCapability.id` 1→20, `encodeEvent`/`_kindOf` (lib/src/wire/wire_protocol.dart) 1→17. Since `CRAP = CC²·(1−cov)³ + CC`, every method whose new CC ≥ 13 breaches the 12.0 threshold **even at 100% coverage**.

CI confirms it — both failures are this branch's own bump, not the pre-existing main red:

- Run [#8624](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38885258141) (a318158): `CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)` **exit 2** and `Flutter app CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml)` **exit 2**.
- Run [#8633](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38895381451) (201416d, after the main merges): **both failed again** the same way. Exit 2 is `ExitCodes.thresholdExceeded` — "maximum CRAP score exceeded the configured threshold".

The current head (1461602b) differs from the red 201416d only by the gh-1649 publish fix, so the next validation run fails the same two jobs a third time (owner directive: after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head). Note the pre-commit hook's version case already accepts `0.14.*`, so upgraded dev checkouts hit the same wall locally.

Both red runs also SKIPPED the downstream quality-gate steps (`broken goldens + Type-2 duplication`, app pixel gate) — so the `severity: error` flip has never actually executed in CI.

**Fix (pick one):**
1. Keep the bump, re-measure under 0.14.2 and **deliberately repin both thresholds**, documenting the counting-semantics change in the config comments (same discipline as the previous "bump the ceiling deliberately" rework), **or**
2. Revert this PR's two pin lines to `">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"`, keep only the gh-1646 anti-stop line, and ship the `severity: error` flip + threshold repins as its own card.

For what it's worth, the pixel side of the flip is sound and verified locally at 0.14.2: `broken_goldens` passes clean with the new excludes (225 app + 4 core goldens), `scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed` returns MET, and dropping the single remaining exclude flags exactly `onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` ("solid glyph rectangles") — the config comments are accurate. It's only the CRAP ratchet the bump silently re-broke.

---

### Thread 2 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `v["file"]` can KeyError where the sibling field already uses `.get`**

```python
violations.setdefault(Path(v["file"]).name, v.get("message", ""))
```

`message` is read defensively with `.get(..., "")`, but `file` is indexed directly — a future schema change (or a partial violation entry) raises `KeyError` and kills the harness *after* the JSON already parsed, so the console-format fallback never gets a chance to run. Symmetric handling keeps the dual-mode parsing actually resilient:

```python
path = v.get("file", "")
if path:
    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name, v.get("message", ""))
```

Verified the current 0.14.2 JSON shape (`gates[].violations[].file/.message`) matches this parser, so this is purely forward-hardening, not a live bug.

---

### Thread 3 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
💡 **SUGGESTION: the hardcoded "30/40" residual prose will rot with the next upstream release**

```python
print(f"  detected: {len(reg_violations)}/{total}"
      f" (0/40 = the measured blind spot; 30/40 with"
      f" crap4dart >=0.14.2 — the residual 10 carry only"
      ...
```

The measured count is printed from `len(reg_violations)` (good — the old `len({*reg_violations}) & len(...) and ...` truthiness hack is genuinely gone), but the parenthetical hardcodes `30/40` and "the residual 10" — numbers valid only for exactly 0.14.2. The next detector release that flags one more box makes this line lie on every scoreboard run. Suggest keeping the prose explanation in the module docstring (where the 0.9.5 baseline classes already live) and printing just the measured fraction plus the pinned version, e.g.:

```python
print(f"  detected: {len(reg_violations)}/{total}"
      f" (0/40 = the 0.9.5 blind spot; expectations per detector"
      f" version live in the module docstring)")
```

Also confirmed against the upstream 0.14.2 changelog: "30/40 detected (0/40 before 0.14.1); the residual 10 carry only sub-20 px boxes and the fa_mark logo" — the numbers are correct today, they just won't survive a bump.

---

### Thread 5

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The gh-1646 anti-stop line itself is correct, tested (22/22 targeted tests green, analyzer/format clean), and I verified the bundled `broken_goldens` flip locally (gates pass at `severity: error`, `--expect-fixed` MET, exactly one documented residual). But the bundled crap4dart `>=0.14.2` pin **re-broke both CRAP ratchets** — validation runs #8624 and #8633 failed with exit 2 ("maximum CRAP score exceeded the configured threshold") because 0.13.0+ counts switch expressions/`when` guards/if-case guards that 0.11.x didn't (310 methods drift up on this tree), and the thresholds were not repinned. The current head will fail the same two jobs again.

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 BLOCKING — `ci.yml:1668`/`ci.yml:2141`: the 0.14.2 pin breaks the core (12.0) and flutter_app (30.0) CRAP thresholds; red twice, golden-gate steps skipped both times (the `severity: error` flip has never run in CI). Repin deliberately under the new counting, or revert the pin out of this PR.
- ⚠️ IMPORTANT — PR description covers 2 of 6 changed files and its "full-suite delta: zero outside the 8 pre-existing main-red failures" claim contradicts the branch's own CI record (both red runs failed the CRAP gates introduced by this branch's bump). Update the description in rework.
- 💡 2 suggestions — `check_golden_detector.py`: defensive `v["file"]` access; hardcoded "30/40" residual prose.

**Next Steps**:
1. Fix the CRAP ratchet regression (repin both thresholds with justification, or move the pin bump + severity flip to a separate card).
2. Correct the PR description to document the crap4dart bump/flip and the real CI delta.
3. Re-validate; the anti-stop line and the golden-detector flip are otherwise ready.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow

# ── Detector invocation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_detector_output(stdout: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parses `crap4dart check --only broken_goldens` output into
    {png basename: message}.

    JSON output carries the FULL violation list (the console report
    truncates at 20 with "... and N more", which silently halved the
    regression count); console lines are the fallback for pins that
    predate --format json. BOTH fields are read defensively: a future
    schema change must degrade to skip-and-continue — a raise here would
    kill the harness after the JSON already parsed, before the console
    fallback ever gets a chance to run.
    """
    violations: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        report = json.loads(stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        report = None
    if isinstance(report, dict):
        for gate in report.get("gates", []):
            for v in gate.get("violations", []):
                if not isinstance(v, dict):
                    continue
                # defensive on BOTH fields (message was already .get);
                # index by basename so callers look fixtures up by name
                path = v.get("file", "")
                if path:
                    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name,
                                          str(v.get("message", "")))
    else:
        for raw in stdout.splitlines():
            s = raw.strip()
            # violation lines: "<dir>/<name>.png: <message>"
            if ": " in s and s.partition(":")[0].strip().endswith(".png"):

        "  broken_goldens:\n"
        "    enabled: true\n"
        f"    dirs: [{scan_dir.relative_to(workdir).as_posix()}]\n"

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1648._

> ℹ️ **18 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `.github/workflows/ci.yml`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
🚨 **BLOCKING: the crap4dart `>=0.14.2` pin breaks both CRAP ratchets — this is what made validation CI red (twice)**

The 0.11.x → 0.14.2 bump changes cyclomatic-complexity counting semantics. crap4dart 0.13.0's changelog: *"Cyclomatic complexity now counts switch **expressions**, their `when` guards, `if-case` guards, and `||`/`&&` patterns — previously all uncounted."* The pinned thresholds were measured under the OLD counting and are not repinned in this PR (core `crap4dart.yaml` stays `threshold: 12.0`, `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml` stays `threshold: 30.0`).

Measured on this tree (complexity-only scan, same 8,066 methods under 0.11.0 vs 0.14.2): **310 methods drift up**, e.g. `_defaultRoleStyle` (lib/src/cli/tui_theme.dart) CC 1→21, `HostCapability.id` 1→20, `encodeEvent`/`_kindOf` (lib/src/wire/wire_protocol.dart) 1→17. Since `CRAP = CC²·(1−cov)³ + CC`, every method whose new CC ≥ 13 breaches the 12.0 threshold **even at 100% coverage**.

CI confirms it — both failures are this branch's own bump, not the pre-existing main red:

- Run [#8624](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38885258141) (a318158): `CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in crap4dart.yaml)` **exit 2** and `Flutter app CRAP ratchet (threshold pinned in flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml)` **exit 2**.
- Run [#8633](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/38895381451) (201416d, after the main merges): **both failed again** the same way. Exit 2 is `ExitCodes.thresholdExceeded` — "maximum CRAP score exceeded the configured threshold".

The current head (1461602b) differs from the red 201416d only by the gh-1649 publish fix, so the next validation run fails the same two jobs a third time (owner directive: after 3 reds on the same head, validation waits for a NEW head). Note the pre-commit hook's version case already accepts `0.14.*`, so upgraded dev checkouts hit the same wall locally.

Both red runs also SKIPPED the downstream quality-gate steps (`broken goldens + Type-2 duplication`, app pixel gate) — so the `severity: error` flip has never actually executed in CI.

**Fix (pick one):**
1. Keep the bump, re-measure under 0.14.2 and **deliberately repin both thresholds**, documenting the counting-semantics change in the config comments (same discipline as the previous "bump the ceiling deliberately" rework), **or**
2. Revert this PR's two pin lines to `">=0.11.0 <0.12.0"`, keep only the gh-1646 anti-stop line, and ship the `severity: error` flip + threshold repins as its own card.

For what it's worth, the pixel side of the flip is sound and verified locally at 0.14.2: `broken_goldens` passes clean with the new excludes (225 app + 4 core goldens), `scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed` returns MET, and dropping the single remaining exclude flags exactly `onboarding_p3_dark_phone.png` ("solid glyph rectangles") — the config comments are accurate. It's only the CRAP ratchet the bump silently re-broke.

---

### Thread 2 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `v["file"]` can KeyError where the sibling field already uses `.get`**

```python
violations.setdefault(Path(v["file"]).name, v.get("message", ""))
```

`message` is read defensively with `.get(..., "")`, but `file` is indexed directly — a future schema change (or a partial violation entry) raises `KeyError` and kills the harness *after* the JSON already parsed, so the console-format fallback never gets a chance to run. Symmetric handling keeps the dual-mode parsing actually resilient:

```python
path = v.get("file", "")
if path:
    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name, v.get("message", ""))
```

Verified the current 0.14.2 JSON shape (`gates[].violations[].file/.message`) matches this parser, so this is purely forward-hardening, not a live bug.

---

### Thread 3 — `scripts/check_golden_detector.py`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
💡 **SUGGESTION: the hardcoded "30/40" residual prose will rot with the next upstream release**

```python
print(f"  detected: {len(reg_violations)}/{total}"
      f" (0/40 = the measured blind spot; 30/40 with"
      f" crap4dart >=0.14.2 — the residual 10 carry only"
      ...
```

The measured count is printed from `len(reg_violations)` (good — the old `len({*reg_violations}) & len(...) and ...` truthiness hack is genuinely gone), but the parenthetical hardcodes `30/40` and "the residual 10" — numbers valid only for exactly 0.14.2. The next detector release that flags one more box makes this line lie on every scoreboard run. Suggest keeping the prose explanation in the module docstring (where the 0.9.5 baseline classes already live) and printing just the measured fraction plus the pinned version, e.g.:

```python
print(f"  detected: {len(reg_violations)}/{total}"
      f" (0/40 = the 0.9.5 blind spot; expectations per detector"
      f" version live in the module docstring)")
```

Also confirmed against the upstream 0.14.2 changelog: "30/40 detected (0/40 before 0.14.1); the residual 10 carry only sub-20 px boxes and the fa_mark logo" — the numbers are correct today, they just won't survive a bump.

---

### Thread 5

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-16):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: The gh-1646 anti-stop line itself is correct, tested (22/22 targeted tests green, analyzer/format clean), and I verified the bundled `broken_goldens` flip locally (gates pass at `severity: error`, `--expect-fixed` MET, exactly one documented residual). But the bundled crap4dart `>=0.14.2` pin **re-broke both CRAP ratchets** — validation runs #8624 and #8633 failed with exit 2 ("maximum CRAP score exceeded the configured threshold") because 0.13.0+ counts switch expressions/`when` guards/if-case guards that 0.11.x didn't (310 methods drift up on this tree), and the thresholds were not repinned. 2. Correct the PR description to document the crap4dart bump/flip and the real CI delta.
3. Re-validate; the anti-stop line and the golden-detector flip are otherwise ready.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow

# ── Detector invocation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_detector_output(stdout: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parses `crap4dart check --only broken_goldens` output into
    {png basename: message}.

    JSON output carries the FULL violation list (the console report
    truncates at 20 with "... and N more", which silently halved the
    regression count); console lines are the fallback for pins that
    predate --format json. BOTH fields are read defensively: a future
    schema change must degrade to skip-and-continue — a raise here would
    kill the harness after the JSON already parsed, before the console
    fallback ever gets a chance to run.
    """
    violations: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        report = json.loads(stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        report = None
    if isinstance(report, dict):
        for gate in report.get("gates", []):
            for v in gate.get("violations", []):
                if not isinstance(v, dict):
                    continue
                # defensive on BOTH fields (message was already .get);
                # index by basename so callers look fixtures up by name
                path = v.get("file", "")
                if path:
                    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name,
                                          str(v.get("message", "")))
    else:
        for raw in stdout.splitlines():
            s = raw.strip()
            # violation lines: "<dir>/<name>.png: <message>"
            if ": " in s and s.partition(":")[0].strip().endswith(".png"):
                path, _, msg = s.partition(":")
                violations.setdefault(Path(path.strip()).name, msg.strip())
    return violations


def run_detector(scan_dir: Path, workdir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Runs the pinned broken_goldens gate over scan_dir; returns
    {png path: violation message}. Empty dict = everything clean."""
    cfg = workdir / "crap4dart.yaml"
    (workdir / "lib").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (workdir / "lib" / "noop.dart").write_text("void main() {}\n")
    cfg.write_text(
        "coverage:\n"
        "  run_tests: false\n"
        "gates:\n"
        "  broken_goldens:\n"
        "    enabled: true\n"
        f"    dirs: [{scan_dir.relative_to(workdir).as_posix()}]\n"
    )
    if not shutil.which("dart"):
        raise SystemExit("dart not on PATH — cannot run the pinned detector")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["dart", "pub", "global", "run", "crap4dart", "check",
         "--only", "broken_goldens", "--format", "json"],
        cwd=workdir,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=DETECTOR_TIMEOUT,
    )
    violations = parse_detector_output(proc.stdout)
    if not violations and proc.returncode not in (0, 2):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"detector run failed rc={proc.returncode}:\n{proc.stdout[-800:]}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}"
        )
    return violations


def classify(violations: dict[str, str], name: str) -> str:
    msg = violations.get(name, "")
    if not msg:
        return "clean"
    return "stripes" if "overflow stripes" in msg else "tofu"


def bucket(got: str) -> str:
    """The verdict class the FIXTURES table speaks: any detection is
    'detect' — the artifact word (stripes/tofu) is display detail."""
    return "detect" if got in ("tofu", "stripes") else got


def extract_regression(workdir: Path) -> Path:
    """The synthetic regression fixture: the 40 pre-font goldens that
    sat in git at f9dce062^ — the exact batch every text glyph of which
    was an Ahem rectangle. Extracted from git history, never stored."""
    dest = workdir / "regression"

            f" crap4dart >=0.14.2 — the residual 10 carry only"
            f" sub-20 px hollow boxes (deliberately not flagged:"
            f" indistinguishable from rounded 16-18 px checkboxes),"
            f" the fa_mark logo (a real image) and sub-glyph-scale"
            f" text)")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--regression", action="store_true",
                    help="also scan the 40 pre-font goldens from f9dce062^")
    ap.add_argument("--expect-fixed", action="store_true",
                    help="exit 1 unless every fixture class already meets "
                         "its target verdict (the upstream-fix flip gate)")
    ap.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true",
                    help="verify the fixture generator, then exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.self_test:
        return self_test()

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="golden-detector-") as td:
        workdir = Path(td)
        scan = workdir / "goldens"
        scan.mkdir()
        for name, (paint, _, _) in FIXTURES.items():
            px = canvas()
            paint(px)
            write_png(scan / name, px)
        violations = run_detector(scan, workdir)

        print(f"pinned detector: crap4dart via `dart pub global run`")
        print(f"{'fixture':32} {'today':8} {'target':8} verdict")
        print("-" * 64)
        rows, all_fixed = [], True
        for name, (_, today, target) in FIXTURES.items():
            got = classify(violations, name)
            ok_today, ok_target = bucket(got) == today, bucket(got) == target
            all_fixed &= ok_target
            print(f"{name:32} {today:8} {target:8} {got:8}"
                  f"{' (matches measured #447 behaviour)' if ok_today else ' <-- CHANGED'}")
        if args.regression:
            reg = extract_regression(workdir)
            reg_violations = run_detector(reg, workdir)
            total = len(list(reg.glob('*.png')))
            print(f"\nregression fixture: {REGRESSION_REF} — {total} pre-font goldens")
            print(regression_note(len(reg_violations), total))
        print()
        if args.expect_fixed:
            print("expect-fixed:", "MET — upstream fixes landed" if all_fixed
                  else "NOT MET — detector still blind/false-positive")
            return 0 if all_fixed else 1
        print("today's scoreboard above is the pinned truth (#447); "
              "re-run with --expect-fixed after upgrading crap4dart to "
              "flip the configs' broken_goldens severity to error.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow

# ── Detector invocation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_detector_output(stdout: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parses `crap4dart check --only broken_goldens` output into
    {png basename: message}.

    JSON output carries the FULL violation list (the console report
    truncates at 20 with "... and N more", which silently halved the
    regression count); console lines are the fallback for pins that
    predate --format json. BOTH fields are read defensively: a future
    schema change must degrade to skip-and-continue — a raise here would
    kill the harness after the JSON already parsed, before the console
    fallback ever gets a chance to run.
    """
    violations: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        report = json.loads(stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        report = None
    if isinstance(report, dict):
        for gate in report.get("gates", []):
            for v in gate.get("violations", []):
                if not isinstance(v, dict):
                    continue
                # defensive on BOTH fields (message was already .get);
                # index by basename so callers look fixtures up by name
                path = v.get("file", "")
                if path:
                    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name,
                                          str(v.get("message", "")))
    else:
        for raw in stdout.splitlines():
            s = raw.strip()
            # violation lines: "<dir>/<name>.png: <message>"
            if ": " in s and s.partition(":")[0].strip().endswith(".png"):
                path, _, msg = s.partition(":")
                violations.setdefault(Path(path.strip()).name, msg.strip())
    return violations


def run_detector(scan_dir: Path, workdir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Runs the pinned broken_goldens gate over scan_dir; returns
    {png path: violation message}. Empty dict = everything clean."""
    cfg = workdir / "crap4dart.yaml"
    (workdir / "lib").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (workdir / "lib" / "noop.dart").write_text("void main() {}\n")
    cfg.write_text(
        "coverage:\n"
        "  run_tests: false\n"
        "gates:\n"
        "  broken_goldens:\n"
        "    enabled: true\n"
        f"    dirs: [{scan_dir.relative_to(workdir).as_posix()}]\n"
    )
    if not shutil.which("dart"):
        raise SystemExit("dart not on PATH — cannot run the pinned detector")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["dart", "pub", "global", "run", "crap4dart", "check",
         "--only", "broken_goldens", "--format", "json"],
        cwd=workdir,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=DETECTOR_TIMEOUT,
    )
    violations = parse_detector_output(proc.stdout)
    if not violations and proc.returncode not in (0, 2):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"detector run failed rc={proc.returncode}:\n{proc.stdout[-800:]}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}"
        )
    return violations


def classify(violations: dict[str, str], name: str) -> str:
    msg = violations.get(name, "")
    if not msg:
        return "clean"
    return "stripes" if "overflow stripes" in msg else "tofu"


def bucket(got: str) -> str:
    """The verdict class the FIXTURES table speaks: any detection is
    'detect' — the artifact word (stripes/tofu) is display detail."""
    return "detect" if got in ("tofu", "stripes") else got

    """The synthetic regression fixture: the 40 pre-font goldens that
    sat in git at f9dce062^ — the exact batch every text glyph of which
    was an Ahem rectangle. Extracted from git history, never stored."""
    dest = workdir / "regression"

        print(f"{'fixture':32} {'today':8} {'target':8} verdict")
        print("-" * 64)

        for name, (_, today, target) in FIXTURES.items():
            got = classify(violations, name)

            all_fixed &= ok_target

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])

# ── Detector invocation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_detector_output(stdout: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parses `crap4dart check --only broken_goldens` output into
    {png basename: message}.

    JSON output carries the FULL violation list (the console report
    truncates at 20 with "... and N more", which silently halved the
    regression count); console lines are the fallback for pins that
    predate --format json. BOTH fields are read defensively: a future
    schema change must degrade to skip-and-continue — a raise here would
    kill the harness after the JSON already parsed, before the console
    fallback ever gets a chance to run.
    """
    violations: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        report = json.loads(stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        report = None
    if isinstance(report, dict):
        for gate in report.get("gates", []):
            for v in gate.get("violations", []):
                if not isinstance(v, dict):
                    continue
                # defensive on BOTH fields (message was already .get);
                # index by basename so callers look fixtures up by name
                path = v.get("file", "")
                if path:
                    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name,
                                          str(v.get("message", "")))
    else:
        for raw in stdout.splitlines():
            s = raw.strip()
            # violation lines: "<dir>/<name>.png: <message>"
            if ": " in s and s.partition(":")[0].strip().endswith(".png"):
                path, _, msg = s.partition(":")
                violations.setdefault(Path(path.strip()).name, msg.strip())
    return violations


def run_detector(scan_dir: Path, workdir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Runs the pinned broken_goldens gate over scan_dir; returns
    {png path: violation message}. Empty dict = everything clean."""
    cfg = workdir / "crap4dart.yaml"
    (workdir / "lib").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (workdir / "lib" / "noop.dart").write_text("void main() {}\n")
    cfg.write_text(
        "coverage:\n"
        "  run_tests: false\n"
        "gates:\n"
        "  broken_goldens:\n"
        "    enabled: true\n"
        f"    dirs: [{scan_dir.relative_to(workdir).as_posix()}]\n"
    )
    if not shutil.which("dart"):
        raise SystemExit("dart not on PATH — cannot run the pinned detector")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["dart", "pub", "global", "run", "crap4dart", "check",
         "--only", "broken_goldens", "--format", "json"],
        cwd=workdir,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=DETECTOR_TIMEOUT,
    )
    violations = parse_detector_output(proc.stdout)
    if not violations and proc.returncode not in (0, 2):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"detector run failed rc={proc.returncode}:\n{proc.stdout[-800:]}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}"
        )
    return violations


def classify(violations: dict[str, str], name: str) -> str:
    msg = violations.get(name, "")
    if not msg:
        return "clean"
    return "stripes" if "overflow stripes" in msg else "tofu"

def regression_note(detected: int, total: int) -> str:

def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--regression", action="store_true",
                    help="also scan the 40 pre-font goldens from f9dce062^")
    ap.add_argument("--expect-fixed", action="store_true",
                    help="exit 1 unless every fixture class already meets "
                         "its target verdict (the upstream-fix flip gate)")
    ap.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true",
                    help="verify the fixture generator, then exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.self_test:
        return self_test()

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="golden-detector-") as td:
        workdir = Path(td)
        scan = workdir / "goldens"
        scan.mkdir()
        for name, (paint, _, _) in FIXTURES.items():
            px = canvas()
            paint(px)
            write_png(scan / name, px)
        violations = run_detector(scan, workdir)

        print(f"pinned detector: crap4dart via `dart pub global run`")
        print(f"{'fixture':32} {'today':8} {'target':8} verdict")
        print("-" * 64)
        rows, all_fixed = [], True
        for name, (_, today, target) in FIXTURES.items():
            got = classify(violations, name)
            ok_today, ok_target = bucket(got) == today, bucket(got) == target
            all_fixed &= ok_target
            print(f"{name:32} {today:8} {target:8} {got:8}"
                  f"{' (matches measured #447 behaviour)' if ok_today else ' <-- CHANGED'}")
        if args.regression:
            reg = extract_regression(workdir)
            reg_violations = run_detector(reg, workdir)
            total = len(list(reg.glob('*.png')))
            print(f"\nregression fixture: {REGRESSION_REF} — {total} pre-font goldens")
            print(regression_note(len(reg_violations), total))
        print()
        if args.expect_fixed:
            print("expect-fixed:", "MET — upstream fixes landed" if all_fixed
                  else "NOT MET — detector still blind/false-positive")
            return 0 if all_fixed else 1
        print("today's scoreboard above is the pinned truth (#447); "
              "re-run with --expect-fixed after upgrading crap4dart to "
              "flip the configs' broken_goldens severity to error.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^

# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )

# ── Detector invocation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_detector_output(stdout: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parses `crap4dart check --only broken_goldens` output into
    {png basename: message}.

    JSON output carries the FULL violation list (the console report
    truncates at 20 with "... and N more", which silently halved the
    regression count); console lines are the fallback for pins that
    predate --format json. BOTH fields are read defensively: a future
    schema change must degrade to skip-and-continue — a raise here would
    kill the harness after the JSON already parsed, before the console
    fallback ever gets a chance to run.
    """
    violations: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        report = json.loads(stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        report = None
    if isinstance(report, dict):
        for gate in report.get("gates", []):
            for v in gate.get("violations", []):
                if not isinstance(v, dict):
                    continue
                # defensive on BOTH fields (message was already .get);
                # index by basename so callers look fixtures up by name
                path = v.get("file", "")
                if path:
                    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name,
                                          str(v.get("message", "")))
    else:
        for raw in stdout.splitlines():
            s = raw.strip()
            # violation lines: "<dir>/<name>.png: <message>"
            if ": " in s and s.partition(":")[0].strip().endswith(".png"):
                path, _, msg = s.partition(":")
                violations.setdefault(Path(path.strip()).name, msg.strip())
    return violations


def run_detector(scan_dir: Path, workdir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Runs the pinned broken_goldens gate over scan_dir; returns
    {png path: violation message}. Empty dict = everything clean."""
    cfg = workdir / "crap4dart.yaml"
    (workdir / "lib").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (workdir / "lib" / "noop.dart").write_text("void main() {}\n")
    cfg.write_text(
        "coverage:\n"
        "  run_tests: false\n"
        "gates:\n"
        "  broken_goldens:\n"
        "    enabled: true\n"
        f"    dirs: [{scan_dir.relative_to(workdir).as_posix()}]\n"
    )
    if not shutil.which("dart"):
        raise SystemExit("dart not on PATH — cannot run the pinned detector")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["dart", "pub", "global", "run", "crap4dart", "check",
         "--only", "broken_goldens", "--format", "json"],
        cwd=workdir,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=DETECTOR_TIMEOUT,
    )
    violations = parse_detector_output(proc.stdout)
    if not violations and proc.returncode not in (0, 2):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"detector run failed rc={proc.returncode}:\n{proc.stdout[-800:]}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}"
        )
    return violations


def classify(violations: dict[str, str], name: str) -> str:
    msg = violations.get(name, "")
    if not msg:
        return "clean"
    return "stripes" if "overflow stripes" in msg else "tofu"


def bucket(got: str) -> str:
    """The verdict class the FIXTURES table speaks: any detection is
    'detect' — the artifact word (stripes/tofu) is display detail."""
    return "detect" if got in ("tofu", "stripes") else got

def regression_note(detected: int, total: int) -> str:
    """The --regression footnote line."""
    return (f"  detected: {detected}/{total}"
            f" (0/40 = the measured blind spot; 30/40 with"
            f" crap4dart >=0.14.2 — the residual 10 carry only"
            f" sub-20 px hollow boxes (deliberately not flagged:"
            f" indistinguishable from rounded 16-18 px checkboxes),"
            f" the fa_mark logo (a real image) and sub-glyph-scale"
            f" text)")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--regression", action="store_true",
                    help="also scan the 40 pre-font goldens from f9dce062^")
    ap.add_argument("--expect-fixed", action="store_true",
                    help="exit 1 unless every fixture class already meets "
                         "its target verdict (the upstream-fix flip gate)")
    ap.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true",
                    help="verify the fixture generator, then exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.self_test:
        return self_test()

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="golden-detector-") as td:
        workdir = Path(td)
        scan = workdir / "goldens"
        scan.mkdir()
        for name, (paint, _, _) in FIXTURES.items():
            px = canvas()
            paint(px)
            write_png(scan / name, px)
        violations = run_detector(scan, workdir)

        print(f"pinned detector: crap4dart via `dart pub global run`")
        print(f"{'fixture':32} {'today':8} {'target':8} verdict")
        print("-" * 64)
        rows, all_fixed = [], True
        for name, (_, today, target) in FIXTURES.items():
            got = classify(violations, name)
            ok_today, ok_target = bucket(got) == today, bucket(got) == target
            all_fixed &= ok_target
            print(f"{name:32} {today:8} {target:8} {got:8}"
                  f"{' (matches measured #447 behaviour)' if ok_today else ' <-- CHANGED'}")
        if args.regression:
            reg = extract_regression(workdir)
            reg_violations = run_detector(reg, workdir)
            total = len(list(reg.glob('*.png')))
            print(f"\nregression fixture: {REGRESSION_REF} — {total} pre-font goldens")
            print(regression_note(len(reg_violations), total))
        print()
        if args.expect_fixed:
            print("expect-fixed:", "MET — upstream fixes landed" if all_fixed
                  else "NOT MET — detector still blind/false-positive")
            return 0 if all_fixed else 1
        print("today's scoreboard above is the pinned truth (#447); "
              "re-run with --expect-fixed after upgrading crap4dart to "
              "flip the configs' broken_goldens severity to error.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Detector regression harness for the crap4dart broken_goldens gate (#447).

crap4dart 0.9.5's detector knows exactly three shapes (yellow/black
overflow stripes, the dark-red build-error screen, icon tofu = bordered
square WITH an X). The issue measured what that means for this repo:

  BLIND SPOTS (broken goldens pass as clean):
    - solid Ahem text rectangles   — how every de2f11b9 pre-font golden
                                     actually broke (40/40 missed);
    - hollow icon squares without an X — what an unloaded MaterialIcons
                                     font really draws.
  FALSE POSITIVES (clean goldens flagged):
    - the Habit Tracker checkmark tile: the white V converges exactly
      like the X signature (light theme, 5 goldens);
    - yellow "25:00" digits on the dark timer card: glyph edges pass
      the stripe heuristic (panel_dark).

The detector fixes belong to upstream (IstiN/crap4dart). This harness
pins the truth HERE, as synthetic pixel fixtures — one per class — so
re-verification after every upstream release is one command:

    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py                # scoreboard
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --regression   # + the 40
                                        # pre-font goldens from f9dce062^
    python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --expect-fixed # CI-flippable:
                                        # exit 1 until upstream fixes land

Fixtures are generated at runtime (no binary blobs in git). Each class
asserts a verdict from the PINNED detector (`dart pub global run
crap4dart`), never from a re-implementation — the scoreboard IS the
test, and `--expect-fixed` is the flip-to-error gate for the configs.

Self-test: python3 scripts/check_golden_detector.py --self-test
"""

import argparse
import json
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
REGRESSION_REF = "f9dce062^:flutter_app/test/golden/goldens"
DETECTOR_TIMEOUT = 180  # s — the gate decodes every PNG it is handed


# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )


# ── Fixture canvas helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

WHITE = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (10, 10, 10)  # classifies as stripe-black (<60 each), never yellow

# ── Detector invocation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_detector_output(stdout: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parses `crap4dart check --only broken_goldens` output into
    {png basename: message}.

    JSON output carries the FULL violation list (the console report
    truncates at 20 with "... and N more", which silently halved the
    regression count); console lines are the fallback for pins that
    predate --format json. BOTH fields are read defensively: a future
    schema change must degrade to skip-and-continue — a raise here would
    kill the harness after the JSON already parsed, before the console
    fallback ever gets a chance to run.
    """
    violations: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        report = json.loads(stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        report = None
    if isinstance(report, dict):
        for gate in report.get("gates", []):
            for v in gate.get("violations", []):
                if not isinstance(v, dict):
                    continue
                # defensive on BOTH fields (message was already .get);
                # index by basename so callers look fixtures up by name
                path = v.get("file", "")
                if path:
                    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name,
                                          str(v.get("message", "")))
    else:
        for raw in stdout.splitlines():
            s = raw.strip()
            # violation lines: "<dir>/<name>.png: <message>"
            if ": " in s and s.partition(":")[0].strip().endswith(".png"):
                path, _, msg = s.partition(":")
                violations.setdefault(Path(path.strip()).name, msg.strip())
    return violations


def run_detector(scan_dir: Path, workdir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Runs the pinned broken_goldens gate over scan_dir; returns
    {png path: violation message}. Empty dict = everything clean."""
    cfg = workdir / "crap4dart.yaml"
    (workdir / "lib").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (workdir / "lib" / "noop.dart").write_text("void main() {}\n")
    cfg.write_text(
        "coverage:\n"
        "  run_tests: false\n"
        "gates:\n"
        "  broken_goldens:\n"
        "    enabled: true\n"
        f"    dirs: [{scan_dir.relative_to(workdir).as_posix()}]\n"
    )
    if not shutil.which("dart"):
        raise SystemExit("dart not on PATH — cannot run the pinned detector")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["dart", "pub", "global", "run", "crap4dart", "check",
         "--only", "broken_goldens", "--format", "json"],
        cwd=workdir,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=DETECTOR_TIMEOUT,
    )
    violations = parse_detector_output(proc.stdout)
    if not violations and proc.returncode not in (0, 2):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"detector run failed rc={proc.returncode}:\n{proc.stdout[-800:]}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}"
        )
    return violations


def classify(violations: dict[str, str], name: str) -> str:
    msg = violations.get(name, "")
    if not msg:
        return "clean"
    return "stripes" if "overflow stripes" in msg else "tofu"


def bucket(got: str) -> str:
    """The verdict class the FIXTURES table speaks: any detection is
    'detect' — the artifact word (stripes/tofu) is display detail."""
    return "detect" if got in ("tofu", "stripes") else got


def extract_regression(workdir: Path) -> Path:
    """The synthetic regression fixture: the 40 pre-font goldens that
    sat in git at f9dce062^ — the exact batch every text glyph of which
    was an Ahem rectangle. Extracted from git history, never stored."""
    dest = workdir / "regression"

    proc = subprocess.run(

    subprocess.run(["tar", "-x", "-C", str(dest)], input=proc.stdout, check=True)
    return dest


def regression_note(detected: int, total: int) -> str:
    """The --regression footnote line."""
    return (f"  detected: {detected}/{total}"
            f" (0/40 = the measured blind spot; 30/40 with"
            f" crap4dart >=0.14.2 — the residual 10 carry only"
            f" sub-20 px hollow boxes (deliberately not flagged:"
            f" indistinguishable from rounded 16-18 px checkboxes),"
            f" the fa_mark logo (a real image) and sub-glyph-scale"
            f" text)")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--regression", action="store_true",
                    help="also scan the 40 pre-font goldens from f9dce062^")
    ap.add_argument("--expect-fixed", action="store_true",
                    help="exit 1 unless every fixture class already meets "
                         "its target verdict (the upstream-fix flip gate)")
    ap.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true",
                    help="verify the fixture generator, then exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.self_test:
        return self_test()

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="golden-detector-") as td:
        workdir = Path(td)
        scan = workdir / "goldens"
        scan.mkdir()
        for name, (paint, _, _) in FIXTURES.items():
            px = canvas()
            paint(px)
            write_png(scan / name, px)
        violations = run_detector(scan, workdir)

        print(f"pinned detector: crap4dart via `dart pub global run`")
        print(f"{'fixture':32} {'today':8} {'target':8} verdict")
        print("-" * 64)
        rows, all_fixed = [], True
        for name, (_, today, target) in FIXTURES.items():
            got = classify(violations, name)
            ok_today, ok_target = bucket(got) == today, bucket(got) == target
            all_fixed &= ok_target
            print(f"{name:32} {today:8} {target:8} {got:8}"
                  f"{' (matches measured #447 behaviour)' if ok_today else ' <-- CHANGED'}")
        if args.regression:
            reg = extract_regression(workdir)
            reg_violations = run_detector(reg, workdir)
            total = len(list(reg.glob('*.png')))
            print(f"\nregression fixture: {REGRESSION_REF} — {total} pre-font goldens")
            print(regression_note(len(reg_violations), total))
        print()
        if args.expect_fixed:
            print("expect-fixed:", "MET — upstream fixes landed" if all_fixed
                  else "NOT MET — detector still blind/false-positive")
            return 0 if all_fixed else 1
        print("today's scoreboard above is the pinned truth (#447); "
              "re-run with --expect-fixed after upgrading crap4dart to "
              "flip the configs' broken_goldens severity to error.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# ── Minimal PNG writer (8-bit RGB, no interlace) ─────────────────────────

def _chunk(tag: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:
    return (
        struct.pack(">I", len(data))
        + tag
        + data
        + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    )


def write_png(path: Path, px: list[list[tuple[int, int, int]]]) -> None:
    """px[row][col] = (r, g, b)."""
    h, w = len(px), len(px[0])
    raw = b"".join(
        b"\x00" + bytes(v for p in row for v in p) for row in px
    )
    path.write_bytes(
        b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
        + _chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))
        + _chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
        + _chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    )

# ── Detector invocation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

def parse_detector_output(stdout: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parses `crap4dart check --only broken_goldens` output into
    {png basename: message}.

    JSON output carries the FULL violation list (the console report
    truncates at 20 with "... and N more", which silently halved the
    regression count); console lines are the fallback for pins that
    predate --format json. BOTH fields are read defensively: a future
    schema change must degrade to skip-and-continue — a raise here would
    kill the harness after the JSON already parsed, before the console
    fallback ever gets a chance to run.
    """
    violations: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        report = json.loads(stdout)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        report = None
    if isinstance(report, dict):
        for gate in report.get("gates", []):
            for v in gate.get("violations", []):
                if not isinstance(v, dict):
                    continue
                # defensive on BOTH fields (message was already .get);
                # index by basename so callers look fixtures up by name
                path = v.get("file", "")
                if path:
                    violations.setdefault(Path(path).name,
                                          str(v.get("message", "")))
    else:
        for raw in stdout.splitlines():
            s = raw.strip()
            # violation lines: "<dir>/<name>.png: <message>"
            if ": " in s and s.partition(":")[0].strip().endswith(".png"):
                path, _, msg = s.partition(":")
                violations.setdefault(Path(path.strip()).name, msg.strip())
    return violations


def run_detector(scan_dir: Path, workdir: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Runs the pinned broken_goldens gate over scan_dir; returns
    {png path: violation message}. Empty dict = everything clean."""
    cfg = workdir / "crap4dart.yaml"
    (workdir / "lib").mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    (workdir / "lib" / "noop.dart").write_text("void main() {}\n")
    cfg.write_text(
        "coverage:\n"
        "  run_tests: false\n"
        "gates:\n"
        "  broken_goldens:\n"
        "    enabled: true\n"
        f"    dirs: [{scan_dir.relative_to(workdir).as_posix()}]\n"
    )
    if not shutil.which("dart"):
        raise SystemExit("dart not on PATH — cannot run the pinned detector")
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["dart", "pub", "global", "run", "crap4dart", "check",
         "--only", "broken_goldens", "--format", "json"],
        cwd=workdir,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=DETECTOR_TIMEOUT,
    )
    violations = parse_detector_output(proc.stdout)
    if not violations and proc.returncode not in (0, 2):
        raise SystemExit(
            f"detector run failed rc={proc.returncode}:\n{proc.stdout[-800:]}\n{proc.stderr[-800:]}"
        )
    return violations


def classify(violations: dict[str, str], name: str) -> str:
    msg = violations.get(name, "")
    if not msg:
        return "clean"
    return "stripes" if "overflow stripes" in msg else "tofu"


def bucket(got: str) -> str:
    """The verdict class the FIXTURES table speaks: any detection is
    'detect' — the artifact word (stripes/tofu) is display detail."""
    return "detect" if got in ("tofu", "stripes") else got

def regression_note(detected: int, total: int) -> str:
    """The --regression footnote line."""
    return (f"  detected: {detected}/{total}"
            f" (0/40 = the measured blind spot; 30/40 with"
            f" crap4dart >=0.14.2 — the residual 10 carry only"
            f" sub-20 px hollow boxes (deliberately not flagged:"
            f" indistinguishable from rounded 16-18 px checkboxes),"
            f" the fa_mark logo (a real image) and sub-glyph-scale"
            f" text)")


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    ap.add_argument("--regression", action="store_true",
                    help="also scan the 40 pre-font goldens from f9dce062^")
    ap.add_argument("--expect-fixed", action="store_true",
                    help="exit 1 unless every fixture class already meets "
                         "its target verdict (the upstream-fix flip gate)")
    ap.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true",
                    help="verify the fixture generator, then exit")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if args.self_test:
        return self_test()

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="golden-detector-") as td:
        workdir = Path(td)
        scan = workdir / "goldens"
        scan.mkdir()
        for name, (paint, _, _) in FIXTURES.items():
            px = canvas()
            paint(px)
            write_png(scan / name, px)
        violations = run_detector(scan, workdir)

        print(f"pinned detector: crap4dart via `dart pub global run`")
        print(f"{'fixture':32} {'today':8} {'target':8} verdict")
        print("-" * 64)
        rows, all_fixed = [], True
        for name, (_, today, target) in FIXTURES.items():
            got = classify(violations, name)
            ok_today, ok_target = bucket(got) == today, bucket(got) == target
            all_fixed &= ok_target
            print(f"{name:32} {today:8} {target:8} {got:8}"
                  f"{' (matches measured #447 behaviour)' if ok_today else ' <-- CHANGED'}")
        if args.regression:
            reg = extract_regression(workdir)
            reg_violations = run_detector(reg, workdir)
            total = len(list(reg.glob('*.png')))
            print(f"\nregression fixture: {REGRESSION_REF} — {total} pre-font goldens")
            print(regression_note(len(reg_violations), total))
        print()
        if args.expect_fixed:
            print("expect-fixed:", "MET — upstream fixes landed" if all_fixed
                  else "NOT MET — detector still blind/false-positive")
            return 0 if all_fixed else 1
        print("today's scoreboard above is the pinned truth (#447); "
              "re-run with --expect-fixed after upgrading crap4dart to "
              "flip the configs' broken_goldens severity to error.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
